title: Antiquated HTML Snippets and Artefacts
summary: A blog post discussing obsolete and deprecated HTML patterns that were once common in web development but are no longer considered best practices, serving as a guide for modernizing legacy code and understanding HTML evolution.
problem_solved: Helps developers identify outdated HTML artifacts and replace them with modern, standards-compliant alternatives.
why_valuable: Keeps web developers informed about deprecated practices and ensures cleaner, more maintainable HTML code in modern web projects.
